Coram : ASHOK BHAN*, C.K. THAKKER
Central Excise Tariff Act, 1985; Chapter Headings 2001.90 and 2107- 2108.90; Notification No.2194/Rules of Interpretation of Schedule I; Rule 3(a): A B c Classification-Harbonic Tonic-Tariff headings 2001.90 or 21071 2108.90-Held: Sub-heading 2108.90 covers other edible preparation not covered covered under specific entry 2001.90 since it is mixture of different vegetation which could be consumed as such-Thus exclusionary note under heading D 20. 08 of Chapter 20 of Harmonised system of Nomenclature not applicable­ Since the product in question covered under specific entry.
Decision Date : 07-12-2005 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 4369/2000 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
